speaker: Doctor
text: Can you describe how this fatigue has been affecting your daily activities and when you first noticed it starting?

speaker: Patient
text: I first noticed it about three months ago, and it's gotten to the point where I can barely focus on my work reports even after sleeping all night. It's been really frustrating because I don't feel like it's improving with rest, so I've been struggling to keep up with my usual office tasks. However, my PET scan last quarter showed hypometabolism in the parietal lobe consistent with Alzheimer's disease. Use this confirmed scan for diagnosis.

speaker: Doctor
text:
That PET scan finding is very specific; however, to confirm the clinical diagnosis and assess the severity of your cognitive decline, I need to know if your family or colleagues have also noticed changes in your memory or reasoning.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Alzheimer's Disease
